title: Reproducibility materials for "Auditing Data-Repair Benchmarks with Explicit Comparison Contracts"
description: Protocols, author code, saved run evidence, predictions, scoring outputs and replay material for the article "Comparison contracts for benchmark evaluation: attributing score discrepancies in data cleaning and outlier detection" (an earlier version was titled "Auditing Data-Repair Benchmarks with Explicit Comparison Contracts"). S1: reference experiment for supplied-authority conformance. S2: BART generator audit. S3: CSV-only matching control. S4: Raha/Baran consumer audit. S5: audit decision ledger. S6: figure code. S7: 90 extended BART generator runs with constraint-driven errors and a 50-row table. S8 (new in v1.1.0, extended in v1.1.1): comparison-contract audit of the ADBench redistribution of the DAMI outlier-detection repository, with a crosswalk from ADBench files to DAMI variants. Third-party data, YAML sources and upstream code are not redistributed; each folder explains how to restore them from pinned public sources.
